_comment: Qwen governor v2 (measured on this B60, 10 Oct 2026). AUTO picks MAX (PC idle) / BALANCED (you are on the PC) / LEAN (heavy load). Context is sized at each load from the VRAM free at that moment minus the profile's free-VRAM margin. DFlash2 drafter (7 tokens) ~43-50 tok/s; generation collapses if free VRAM < ~1.1 GiB, so margins stay >= 1.2 GiB. Variants: default UD-Q4_K_M (best quality), turbo Q4_0 (faster, slightly lower quality), long = native 262k context, no drafter (~15 tok/s).
common_args: Thinking budget reached. Give the final answer now.

calibration._note: governor learns (measured llama VRAM - base_gib - ctx*kv) per variant into calib.json at each post-launch BASELINE; launch.ps1 adds the positive part to base_gib so free VRAM lands near the profile margin instead of 0.65 GiB (2026-10-16)

power._note: v4.2 power-plan hysteresis: PERFORMANCE at once on model activity (busy, or a request within perf_model_recent_sec) or CPU >= cpu_busy_pct for cpu_busy_samples; step down ONE plan at a time only after the lower demand has lasted dwell_min AND the current plan was held dwell_min; never below BALANCED while an agent client is active (auto.agent_processes or a request within auto.agent_recent_min); SAVER only with no input for saver_idle_min AND model quiet for saver_model_quiet_min AND CPU < cpu_calm_pct. power.txt (qwen power ...) still forces a plan immediately.

_v3_note: 2026-10-11 V3: default = ThinkingCap-Qwen3.8-27B Q4_K_M (16/16, 3.9x tasks/min vs base at xhigh); DFlash2 p-min 0.5 (+4.6%); base kept as variant 'base'.
_v4_note: 2026-10-15 V4 governor: PDH readings validated (invalid sample = keep last good, never act); pressure must persist pressure_persist_sec and re-fits/upgrades happen at most every refit_min_interval_min; ram_critical_gb is the acute floor (ram_floor_gb only selects LEAN); agent_processes keep the model warm and block idle unloads; slots = KV slot save before governor unloads / restore after its relaunch (needs --slot-save-path in common_args). ctx_target_min is only logged by launch.ps1 when the fit falls short (f16 KV: 61440 needs others <= ~1.6 GiB in MAX). v4.1: a re-fit needs OTHER apps to have grown >= others_growth_gib since the post-launch baseline (or free < vram_free_hard_floor_gib); footprint calibration via calib.json.
_v43_note: 2026-10-17 v4.3 (ctxlab): (1) ProcIds/launch.ps1 count only C:\AI\llama.cpp\* llama-server processes - Ollama's runner (Ollama's bundled llama-server.exe, llama3.2:3b, 3.07 GiB, OLLAMA_KEEP_ALIVE=24h) was being booked as the model, so others read 3 GiB low and free VRAM sat at 0.56 GiB. (2) BALANCED free margin 1.5 -> 1.35 (same as MAX; measured cliff is ~1.1 GiB, post-launch free was 3.06 GiB at ctx 45056 once the Ollama runner was gone). KV stays f16: q8_0 KV measured -53% prefill and -57% decode at 25K depth (Intel FA kernels require f16 K and V) and saved only 0.27 GiB of dedicated VRAM at 40960.
_v44_note: 2026-10-18 published defaults: MAX/BALANCED free_margin_gib 2.5 and auto.others_vram_max_gib 2.5. A fit on adapter dedicated-free VRAM is not a real fit: at margin 1.35 the governor chose ctx 57344 and llama-server spilled 2.90 GiB into WDDM shared memory (20-22 tok/s). Margin 2.5 landed ctx 36864 with 1.23 GiB shared (26.7-28.3 tok/s). Re-qualify the margin on your desktop with the shared-usage check in docs/FIELD-REPORT-20261018.md.
